what: While the full-height panel is pinned at the top, a circular window (diameter 46.2vh) at the panel’s bottom center grows to 130vh, and the clip-path circle that was trimming around it opens from 50% → 100%, so the screen-fixed photo spreads beyond the circle — until the panel’s bottom edge reaches screen center (scrub .5). On phones (751px and below) 66vw → 140vw · 50% → 120%
ease: power1.out (GSAP default — applied to scrub progress)

options.size · grow: Wide-screen start and end diameter, default 46.2vh · 130vh
options.from · open: Wide-screen clip-path circle start and end, default 50% · 100%
options.end: Place where it finishes growing (ScrollTrigger end), default ”bottom center”
options.--fx-circle-top · --fx-circle-top-md · -: Circle top-edge position (css), default min(44.44vh,480px) · 1281 and below min(33.33vh,360px) · phone min(80vw,600px)
options.--fx-size · --fx-size-sp: Initial diameter (css) kept under reduced motion, default 46.2vh · 66vw
options.[data-fx-part=circle] > [data-fx-part=me: Circle window (child) and the photo inside it — the photo stays fixed to the screen

note: With reduced motion set, the circle stays at its initial size (as in the original)

from.where: menu.js·menu.css .z-hero__wrap > .z-hero__pic — menu page hero. Original script.js .is-hero · .is-big

index.html .h-grow (Make your ○ sales grow) — original HomeGrow: while the panel is pinned, progress drives the timeline, the full-bleed video’s clip-path circle goes from a small circle → 100% (ease none), the words on both sides gather to x 0 and the video plays in place = Length × progress. Only the clip circle grows, not the original window size, so via this part’s options "from: 7.3%; open: 100%; ease: none" Set size·grow to the screen size
